clauses.clause: Affinity for Gates (This spell costs {1} less to cast for each Gate you control.)
This creature can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.
Whenever a Gate you control enters, you may put this card from your graveyard on top of your library.

mapping.notes: Affinity for Gates as Claws Out's mapped CostModifier (1 per Gate you control); Juggernaut's mapped 'can't be blocked by Walls' with blockers of power 2 or less; a Gate-enters trigger moving this card from your graveyard to the top of your library, optional (works from the graveyard only, CR 113.6m). G0 warns AFFINITY has no Keyword atom (it is the cost modifier). packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: gate_colossus_costs_one_less_per_gate, gate_colossus_small_creatures_cannot_block, gate_colossus_gate_puts_it_on_top_of_your_library, gate_colossus_declined_stays_in_the_graveyard. Ontology round R12: the tree translated into the one comparison (same meaning), the draft, clauses and notes reworded.
